question: Estimate the number of Indians who travel for Eid (UP, Bihar, Bengal — homes-village migration).
idealClarificationQuestions: Inter-city/inter-state migration of urban Muslims back to ancestral homes? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian Muslim population × urban share × home-travel rate.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian Muslim population: ~21 crore (~14.5% of India).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of these, with strong rural ancestral ties (UP, Bihar, Bengal, AP, MP): ~5-6 crore.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus international Muslim Indians returning: small, ~5 lakh.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~2-2.5 crore Indians travel for Eid migration.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of these, with strong rural ancestral ties (UP, Bihar, Bengal, AP, MP)
Of these, who travel to home village/town for Eid

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~2-2.5 crore Indians travel for Eid migration.

calculationFlow: Indian Muslim population: ~21 crore (~14.5% of India).
Of these, with strong rural ancestral ties (UP, Bihar, Bengal, AP, MP): ~5-6 crore.
Of these, who travel to home village/town for Eid: ~30-40% = ~2-2.5 crore.
Plus international Muslim Indians returning: small, ~5 lakh.
Round: ~2-2.5 crore Indians travel for Eid migration.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: ~2-2.5 crore Indians travel for Eid migration.
